newsitem.title: POLAND: Gdanski, BIG to merge brokers.
newsitem.headline: Gdanski, BIG to merge brokers.

text.p: Poland's Bank Gdanski SA and Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych SA (BIG) agreed on Thursday to merge their broking operations, BIG said in a statement.
It said that under the agreement BIG's broking subsidiary Dom Maklerski BIG Sp z o.o. would incorporate Gdanski's securities unit and take over its clients.

"The agreement stipulates that as a result of the planned merger of brokerage firms, the Dom Maklerski BIG Sp z o.o., in a new ownership structure with Bank Gdanski, will continue to offer its services to clients of Bank Gdanski brokerage," the statement said.
Early last month BIG became a majority owner of Bank Gdanski after it doubled its stake to about 63 percent, buying shares from state treasury.
